distinctions.subject: Definition Evaluation Profile
distinctions.question: Which versioned check contract applies versus which execution produced evidence?
distinctions.example: The same profile can produce multiple evaluations; the profile exists before any evaluation.

distinctions.subject: Definition Lifecycle Profile
distinctions.question: Which transition rules apply versus which state is recorded, which effect was selected, or which general policy constrains behavior?
distinctions.example: The completeness record remains authored although the profile declares admission gates. A Decision selection is separately confirmed by application.
